intent_summary: A lagged-response relationship compares current response with a supplied or training-fitted multiple of an earlier predictor.

criteria.criterion: A supplied lag and coefficient use the predictor at the declared earlier sample position.
criteria.notes: Supplied lag/coefficient uses the declared earlier predictor position and preserves the expected response residual.

criteria.criterion: Derived values retain response and predictor source indexes and source cutoffs in lineage.
criteria.notes: Available and pending lineage retains existing source indexes and timestamp cutoffs; missing predictors do not become zero.

criteria.criterion: When requested, the coefficient is fitted once from a declared training prefix and remains frozen.
criteria.notes: The coefficient is fitted once after the complete declared prefix; the independent 20/7 result and prefix-invariance assertions pass.

criteria.criterion: Samples lacking the earlier predictor or awaiting coefficient training remain unavailable.
criteria.notes: Short prefixes retain null derived values and explicit unavailable reasons, while an unidentifiable completed fit has a visible error.
